However, the presence of a relatively high necrotic component (Proportion Necrosis) and extensive peritumoral edema (Proportion of Oedema) are more commonly seen in IDH‑wildtype glioblastoma, creating some discordance. Balancing these, the preponderance of features points toward IDH‑mutant status.
